spec.description:
Consumables, print history, and sync health for bambu-sync — a Prometheus exporter for the Bambu cloud API, running in Kubernetes (namespace bambu, full sync daily at 07:00). Live printer/AMS telemetry, including AMS humidity, lives on the Bambulab Metrics dashboard.

EXAMPLE dashboard shipped with github.com/chewrocca/bambu-sync. Set the datasource variables on import. Not the maintained copy -- adapt it, do not expect updates.

Whether the last full sync completed successfully. Set on every outcome, so a dead token or API failure shows red rather than going quietly missing. The 30-minute current-print poll deliberately never writes this — otherwise it could hold the signal green through a failure of the daily sync.
spec.title: Last sync

spec.description: Time since the last full sync attempt, success or fail. It runs daily at 07:00 local -- this should rarely read more than a day or so old. Anything older means the exporter is not running.
spec.title: Last run

spec.expr: {job="$loki_job"} | json | event="run_summary" | line_format "spools={{.spools_total}} (low={{.spools_low}})  prints={{.prints_succeeded}} ok / {{.prints_failed}} failed  filter={{.filter_percent}}%  humidity={{.humidity_percent}}% ({{.humidity_state}})  alerts={{.alerts_fired}}"

spec.description: One line per run: reorder/filter/humidity snapshot and how many Slack alerts fired.
spec.title: Recent runs

spec.description: The exporter's full log stream, not just the run summary — every line the process emits, structured JSON on stdout. This is the place to look when a run fails. Filter to the summary only with: | json | event="run_summary"

Recent prints from the Bambu cloud API, newest first: model (with the slicer profile beneath it), material, outcome, wall-clock time and filament used. Click a model to open it on MakerWorld. Capped at the 20 most recent — every row is a distinct label set and print history only grows.

spec.description:
Your MakerWorld favorites, synced daily from the Bambu cloud API. Click a name to open it. The number is that design's total print count on MakerWorld, not yours.

This is deliberately NOT the printer's own job queue: the exporter publishes bambulab_queue_*, but those are bare numbers with no job names and read 0 even mid-print.

spec.description: Cumulative print hours on the activated-carbon air filter, as a percentage of its 1,440-hour rated interval. Thresholds match the exporter's own "replace soon" Slack alert (fires at 90%).
spec.title: Air filter wear

spec.description: Cumulative costTime across all prints. Resets only when manually reset after a filter replacement.
spec.title: Filter hours (of 1,440)

spec.description:
Days until the Bambu cloud token expires. Re-authentication is MANUAL and interactive (email, password, emailed 2FA code) -- there is no working refresh endpoint, so this cannot fix itself.

The exporter also alerts to Slack daily once inside 14 days, which is where the amber threshold comes from. Red means you are past that window.

When you re-auth, update BOTH the token and its expiry in 1Password -- the token is an opaque string, not a JWT, so the date cannot be derived from it, and updating only the token leaves this panel counting down against a stale value.
spec.title: Token expires in
Maintenance & History
